svg.text: Visualizing time-alignment effect on continuous sEMG
A: whole segment overview. B: zoomed single-event panels. C: per-event correction relative to original public event time.
The full segment shows all events and checks whether alignment changes are globally reasonable.
Each panel is centered on one original event time. Local views make the before/after movement visible.
Blue is the artificially shifted input error. Red is the recovered alignment error relative to the original public event time.
Summary: MAE before alignment = 0.250s; MAE after alignment = 0.053s
